item.title: Rail strategy priorities Galway and the West
item.description: The Galway Minister with responsibility for implementation of the All-Island Strategic Rail Review has welcomes prioritisation of Galway and Western rail projects under plan. Minister of State Seán Canney said the Prioritisation Strategy would deliver both immediate improvements and long-term transformation for rail services in Galway and across the West of Ireland. item.title: Legal Aid Board sees Christmas as time to talk about changing priorities
item.description: The Legal Aid Board is encouraging people across the city and county to use the Christmas period – a time when families naturally come together – to have open, supportive conversations about future decision-making, rights, and the kind of help a person may want as they grow older and face changing health needs. item.title: Seven Galway projects funded under Town and Village Renewal Scheme
item.description: Seven Galway locations have been earmarked for a new lease of life after they were included this week in the latest €26 million investment under the Town and Village Renewal Scheme.
